items.title: 10.1 Yaksan magnetic field mein current wale conductor par force (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 10.1 in the book's order (PDF 230-232), with the Fig. 10.2 correction, Example 10.1 and a self-check.

blocks.text: Tajurbe (experiment) se dekha gaya hai ke magnetic field mein rakhe current wale conductor par force lagti hai. Ek seedha conductor lein jis mein mustaqil (steady) current beh raha hai aur jo uniform (yaksan) magnetic field ke perpendicular (amudi, 90° par) rakha hai. Farz karein current kaghaz se bahar ki taraf hai, jise Fig. 10.2 mein ⊙ se dikhaya gaya hai. Current se banne wali magnetic field ki simt bhi dikhayi gayi hai.

Jaise do magnets apni magnetic fields ke zariye ek doosre par force lagate hain, waise hi current wale conductor par us ki apni magnetic field aur bahar ki (external) magnetic field ke aapas ke asar se force lagti hai. Is force ki simt jaanne ke liye dono fields ka milna dekhein.

blocks.alt: Conductor ka sira samne se dikhaya gaya hai, us mein nuqta batata hai ke current kaghaz se bahar hai. Yeh do pole blocks ke darmiyan hai: oopar S aur neeche N. Khari field lines N se S ki taraf oopar ja rahi hain. Neele daire anticlockwise teeron ke saath conductor ki apni field dikhate hain. Force F ka teer ufuqi baen taraf hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 10.2: Yaksan magnetic field mein current wala conductor: current kaghaz se bahar aur force F (kitab ki Figure 10.2 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ki Fig. 10.2 mein N pole oopar aur S pole neeche chhapa hai. Magnet ke bahar field N se S ki taraf jati hai, is liye N oopar ho to field neeche ki taraf hogi, aur kaghaz se bahar current par force F = I L × B daen (right) taraf banegi. Text kehta hai force baen (left) taraf hai; yeh tabhi sahi hai jab field oopar ki taraf ho, yani S oopar aur N neeche. Isi liye humne poles is tarah banaye hain.

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Check karein: conductor ki apni field (neele daire) anticlockwise hai. Daen taraf yeh oopar ki taraf hai aur bahar ki field (oopar) se mil kar mazboot hoti hai; baen taraf yeh neeche ki taraf hai aur bahar ki field ko kamzor karti hai. Is liye conductor baen taraf, kamzor field ki taraf, dhakela jata hai.

Current ki field aur bahar ki uniform field conductor ki daen (right) taraf ek doosre ko mazboot (reinforce) karti hain aur baen (left) taraf ek doosre ko khatam (cancel) karti hain. Nateeja yeh ke conductor us taraf chalta hai jahan field kamzor ho, yani force baen taraf hai. Is tarah force F conductor aur magnetic field dono ke perpendicular hai. Current wale conductor par force ki simt Fleming ke left-hand rule se maloom ki jati hai. Rule yeh hai:

blocks.title: Fleming ka left-hand rule
blocks.text: Apna baya (left) haath is tarah rakhein ke pehli ungli (shahadat ki ungli) magnetic field ki simt mein ho aur doosri (darmiyani) ungli current ki simt mein; tab angootha force ki simt batayega.
Force ki simt right-hand rule se bhi maloom ki ja sakti hai:

blocks.title: Right hand rule
blocks.text: Daen (right) haath ki ungliyan current se magnetic field ki taraf chhote zawiye (angle) se moriye; khula hua angootha force ki simt batayega.
Fleming ka left-hand rule Fig. 10.3 mein dikhaya gaya hai.

blocks.alt: Baya (left) haath: angootha seedha oopar, Force; pehli (shahadat ki) ungli daen oopar ki taraf, Magnetic Field; aur doosri (darmiyani) ungli daen neeche ki taraf, Current. Teenon aapas mein amudi (right angles) hain; baqi do ungliyan mudi hui hain.
blocks.caption: Figure 10.3: Fleming ka left-hand rule (kitab ki Figure 10.3 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Teenon simtein aapas mein amudi hain. Pehli ungli field (B) ki taraf, doosri ungli current (I) ki taraf karein; angootha force (F) batata hai. Fig. 10.2 par lagayein: pehli ungli oopar (field), doosri ungli aap ki taraf (current kaghaz se bahar); angootha baen taraf aata hai, yaani force baen taraf.

blocks.alt: Bar magnet: baen taraf S (hara) aur daen taraf N (surkh). Kham-daar field lines N sire se nikal kar S sire mein wapas jati hain; teer N se door aur S ki taraf hain, aur lines ek doosre ko nahi kaatti.
blocks.caption: Do You Know? (PDF page 230): Bar magnet ki magnetic field lines (kitab ke is box ki tasveer ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Field lines magnet ke bahar N se nikal kar S mein dakhil hoti hain. Jahan lines ghani (qareeb qareeb) hain wahan field taqatwar hai, yaani poles ke qareeb. Lines kabhi ek doosre ko nahi kaatti.

Ab magnetic field mein rakhe current wale conductor par force ki miqdar (magnitude) nikalte hain. Tajurbe se dekha gaya hai ke force conductor mein current I, conductor ki lambai L aur bahar ki magnetic field ki taqat B, teenon ke directly proportional (seedhe tanasub mein) hai, yani in mein se koi bhi doguna ho to force doguni. Magnetic field ki taqat ko magnetic induction B bhi kehte hain, aur is ki simt field wali hi hai. Is tarah lambai L, current I wale aur field B ke perpendicular rakhe conductor par force F yeh hai:
SI units mein k = 1 hai. Is liye,
Eq. (10.1) se B = F/IL milta hai, is liye B ki tareef (definition) yeh hai:

blocks.title: Magnetic field ki taqat
blocks.text: Magnetic field ki taqat adadi taur par us force ke barabar hai jo field ke perpendicular rakhe, 1 metre lambe aur 1 ampere current wale conductor par lagti hai.
B = F/IL se B ki unit bhi milti hai. B ki SI unit tesla (T) hai:
Yaad rahe ke magnetic induction vector quantity (simt wali miqdar) hai; is ki simt magnetic field ki simt hai.
Hum ek vector L bhi le sakte hain jis ki miqdar conductor ki lambai ke barabar ho aur simt current ke bahao ki taraf.

blocks.alt: Ek hi nuqte se vector B seedha oopar aur vector L daen oopar, B se zawiya θ par. Usi nuqte se ufuqi teer, L sinθ, L ke sire ke bilkul neeche khatam hota hai aur khari dashed lakeer se us se jura hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 10.4: L ka B ke amudi juz (component) L sinθ (kitab ki Figure 10.4 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: L ko do hisson mein torein: B ke saath wala hissa force nahi deta; sirf B ke amudi hissa L sinθ force deta hai. Is liye F = BIL sinθ. θ = 90° par poora L amudi hai (force zyada se zyada) aur θ = 0 par amudi hissa sifar (force sifar).
Ab agar conductor L magnetic field se zawiya θ banaye, to hum L ka sirf woh hissa (component) lete hain jo B ke perpendicular hai, yani L sinθ (Fig. 10.4). Tab Eq. (10.1) yeh ban jati hai:
Vector shakal mein Eq. 10.2 yun likhte hain:
Eq. (10.2) batati hai ke force sab se zyada (BIL) tab hai jab conductor field ke perpendicular ho, yani θ = 90°, aur zero tab hai jab conductor field ke saath (along) ho, yani θ = 0.

blocks.title: Interesting Information
blocks.text: Zameen ki magnetic field taqreeban ek dipole jaisi hai, jaise Zameen ke andar ek farzi (khayali) bar magnet rakha ho. Is magnet ka south magnetic pole jughrafiyai (geographic) north pole ki taraf aur north magnetic pole geographic south pole ki taraf hai.

blocks.alt: Zameen ke andar farzi bar magnet, jughrafiyai (geographic) axis (dashed) se thora jhuka hua. Field lines dipole ki tarah Zameen ke junoobi hisse se nikal kar shimali hisse tak ghoomti hain. Labels: oopar South magnetic pole aur Geographic North pole; neeche Geographic South pole aur North magnetic pole.
blocks.caption: Interesting Information (PDF page 231): Zameen ki magnetic field taqreeban dipole jaisi hai (kitab ke is box ki tasveer ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Farzi magnet ka S sira jughrafiyai shimal (North) ki taraf hai, isi liye compass ki sui ka N sira shimal ki taraf jata hai: mukhtalif poles ek doosre ko khainchte hain. Magnetic axis jughrafiyai axis se thora jhuka hua hai.

blocks.title: Example 10.1
blocks.problem: 20.0 cm lamba taar jis mein 10.0 A current hai, 0.30 T ki uniform magnetic field mein rakha hai. Agar taar magnetic field ki simt se 40° ka zawiya banaye to taar par force ki miqdar nikalein.
steps: Taar ki lambai = L = 20.0 cm = 0.20 m (cm ko metre mein badla)
Eq. (10.2) mein rakhein: F = BIL sinθ = 10.0 A × 0.30 T × 0.20 m × sin 40°

blocks.prompt: 2 m lamba current wala conductor PQ 0.5 T ki magnetic field ke perpendicular rakha hai aur us par 1 N force lagti hai. Current nikalein (numerical 10.12; kitab mein number 7.12 chhapa hai). Uniform field mein current wale conductor par force ka formula nikalein (comprehensive question 10.2).
blocks.explanation: I = F/(BL) = 1/(0.5 × 2) = 1 A; is ki simt Fleming ke left-hand rule se milti hai. Formula: force I, L aur B ke proportional hai, F = kBIL, aur SI mein k = 1, to F = BIL. Agar taar field se zawiya θ banaye to sirf L sinθ field ke aar paar hai, is liye F = BIL sinθ, ya vector shakal mein F = I L × B.

blocks.text: Mukhtasar khulasa

items: Magnetic field mein current wale conductor par force lagti hai: us ki apni field ek taraf bahar ki field ko mazboot aur doosri taraf kamzor karti hai, aur conductor kamzor taraf jata hai. Fleming ka left-hand rule: pehli ungli field, doosri ungli current, angootha force.
F = BIL (10.1); B = F/IL, unit tesla, 1 T = 1 N A⁻¹ m⁻¹; F = BIL sinθ (10.2); F = I L × B (10.3); perpendicular par sab se zyada, field ke saath zero. Example 10.1: 0.39 N.
